Central to our approach is that we do not assume ownership of a problem, but rather enable others to gain insights themselves and then make progress. We do this through advisory work, research, and model development, with our main product being the open-source and open-access Energy Transition Model (ETM). 
 About our internships 
As an intern you will do analysis and/or modelling work that is directly relevant for Quintel's mission. Depending on your background and skills, you'll be oriented more toward supporting our Consulting team or our Modelling & Development team. You'll work closely with our advisors and/or modellers on activities such as: 
Oriented towards analysis: - Research the latest developments in the production of synthetic fuels - Determine how to translate national energy scenarios to provinces or municipalities - Determine how to align definitions used in the ETM with (inter)national standards - Compare tools currently used to explore solutions to grid congestion
